**Publish gate report: landing hero**

**Going out:** Landing page hero, UK audience, Pebblebrook Tea Co.

**Claims check**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website" | On the policy list (4.8 out of 5, over 1,200 reviews, on our website). The wording matches. |
| "Organic loose leaf" | On the policy list (certified organic by the Soil Association). |
| "plastic-free bags" | On the policy list (plastic-free tea bags). |
| "packed by hand in Bristol" | On the policy list (every tin is packed by hand in Bristol). |

**Regulated claims:** "Plastic-free" is a green claim, but it is narrow, specific and on the policy list, so it is fine. There are no health, money, price or urgency claims.

**House style:** No AI tells, no banned words and no padding. It is short, concrete and plain.

**Disclosure:** This is the brand's own page, so there is no ad, affiliate, sponsorship or AI-labelling requirement.

**Fixed:** Nothing needed changing.

**Worth a glance (not blocking):**
- The policy says "every *tin* is packed by hand." If the plastic-free bags ship in boxes or pouches rather than tins, "packed by hand" covers them only loosely. If that's the case, say "every tin packed by hand in Bristol."
- Confirm the rating and review count are still current on the site. The page can't claim more than the live review numbers show.

**Approver:** The policy names no approver, so please confirm with the user (the account holder) or the person who owns the page. I haven't recorded any approval, and I can't, because I have no tools in this session. Someone needs to say an explicit yes to this exact copy before it goes live.
